In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the forces of [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mon Julpa]] and [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Malameu Toda]] rescued Toda's daughter, [[Gerin Toda|Gerin]], after she was captured by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]]. Gerin was taken as a hostage by Ren when the pirate escaped from Tammuz-an after he and his crew were captured during the [[Battle of Tammuz-an]]. Fleeing to the [[bog moon of Bogden]], the pirate [[Captain/Legends|captain]] attempted to use Gerin as leverage to secure the release of his crew and his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Dianoga (starship)|''Dianoga'']]. Mon Julpa dispatched [[Jann Tosh]], [[Jessica Meade]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to rescue Gerin but, after arriving, the group were attacked by a pack of [[sungwa]]s. When Ren reported the failure of the rescue mission, Toda agreed to turn Julpa and Ren's crew over to him in exchange for Gerin's release. However, Toda and several of his [[Trooper/Legends|guards]] hid aboard the ''Dianoga'' and took Ren by surprise, securing his capture and Gerin's return.
